lines: d42: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Leroy Pang is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d42: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d42: 🕯️ Leroy Pang is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d42: What Leroy kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d42: "Leroy's gone." Nora looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Leroy." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d42: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Scarlett blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.

d42: 📖 LEARNED: Diplomatic Incident (Level 1). Trust builds 2x faster. You're TOO good though — once per week you can start a diplomatic incident: villagers argue, you pick the winner (+trust with them, -trust with the loser).
d42: 📖 LEARNED: Field Dressing (Level 1). Break down game fast and clean. Less waste, more meat, usable parts.
d42: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d42: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Leroy Pang, 42 days. The mantle passes to Scarlett Alexander.
d42: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Scarlett Alexander, 31 — a rail conductor. Their hands know different work now: Beast-calm, Lucky Rock, Bloodhound, Trophy Room.
d42: ◈ The System updates its file: the new bearer <redacted> "Stalker of the Apex Predator." It had a word for this one before the Codex came.
d42: The village's quarrel was with Leroy — and Leroy is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d42: At the grave, Nora, Duc, Amina and 2 more speak for Scarlett — "Leroy trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d42: The fire knew Scarlett before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.

d81: The warm hum behind your ribs is gone. The reactor went with Scarlett's body — it does not come out, and it does not pass on. Hunger is back on the table. (One reactor per world, and the world already spent its one.)
